review_candidates.title: Systems & DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: Deligo is a leader in visual AI self-checkout for the convenience retail industry, trusted by global brands like Compass, Sodexo, Marks & Spencer, and Spar. We build advanced visual AI — developed by a top-notch machine learning team — to recognize food and retail items instantly. No barcodes, no manual scanning. Just place your items and tap to pay — it’s that simple. The result: a magical experience that improves everyday lives by saving time standing in checkout lines. But this isn’t just exceptional tech: We are a tight-knit team of curious, passionate and ambitious builders who take pride in our craft and value trust in everything we do. If you’re looking to join a rocket ship and help redefine the future of AI-powered checkout, we’d love to meet you! 🚀 How you’ll make a difference Keep our fleet running reliably: Deploy, configure and update Linux/Jetson and Windows-based systems, working with Docker, Docker Compose and infrastructure tooling such as Terraform Deliver frequent releases: Carry out software and configuration updates across our edge devices, gradually taking on releases for our cloud Recognition Service Investigate production issues: Be the first engineering escalation point for Customer Support. Use SSH, logs, monitoring and system state to diagnose problems, resolve common issues and bring clear findings to senior engineers when you need their help Turn recurring work into lasting improvements: Automate repetitive tasks and improve monitoring, runbooks and deployment processes so that operational effort grows more slowly than the fleet Connect people and systems: Work with Engineering, Customer Support and Sales, communicating technical findings clearly and helping colleagues move issues toward resolution Grow into operational ownership: Start with close supervision, build your understanding of the architecture and progressively take on more independent decisions On-call : Participate in an engineering on-call arrangement as we develop our formal processes What makes you a great fit Relevant professional experience: You bring at least 2-3 years of hands-on experience in systems administration, DevOps, production operations or a similar engineering role, including deploying, maintaining and troubleshooting production systems Practical Linux and systems knowledge: You’re comfortable working in Linux environments and understand how operating systems, services and have strong IP networking fundamentals Hands-on Docker experience: You understand images, containers, volumes, networking, logs and configuration, and can work with containerized applications Infrastructure and deployment fundamentals: You understand repeatable deployments and have used Terraform, Ansible or similar infrastructure automation tooling University degree: You hold a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related technical field - A degree from a leading international university is a strong advantage A systematic approach to troubleshooting: You gather evidence, test hypotheses and narrow down unfamiliar problems - you want to understand why something failed, rather than just put the fire out Ownership and sound judgment: You follow problems through, take care with production changes and know when to involve others. You take pride in reliable operations and look for ways to improve repetitive work Curiosity and a collaborative mindset: You learn proactively, welcome feedback and enjoy helping both technical and non-technical colleagues Bonus Public cloud experience Windows administration or Intune Monitoring and observability CI/CD and release automation Why join us Opportunity to join at an early stage, making a visible impact in a fast-scaling startup Real influence on how our products and processes evolve, with freedom to innovate A collaborative, creative, and transparent culture where contributions are recognized A spacious, shiny, dog-friendly office in the heart of Budapest with great transport, tasty snacks, and vibrant team events High-tech equipment Flexible working hours and hybrid approach Competitive salary Details Start: As soon as you are ready Location: Budapest - we operate with an office-first approach, typically requiring 4-5 days per week in-office Contract: Permanent Compensation: Competitive package based on experience If you’re ready to help build a truly seamless and magical checkout experience, we encourage you to connect and explore future opportunities with Deligo. We’re looking forward to receiving your application!

review_candidates.title: 总经理 - 伊宁中心皇冠假日酒店 & 伊宁中心智选假日酒店
review_candidates.description: As General Manager you will manage the day to day leadership, operations and direction of the hotel, maximising on sales and revenue, driving financial returns, driving great guest experience and running a safe hotel. You’ll take ownership of the development of your people, execute on brand standards and build awareness of the hotel and brand within the local area as well as managing owner relationship and partnership. People Develop programmes and initiatives to increase team engagement that are aligned with the hotel’s service philosophy Develop, implement and monitor team member succession planning to ensure future bench strength Establish performance and development goals for team members and provide mentoring, coaching and regular feedback to enhance performance Oversee HR related actions in accordance with company rules and policies Effectively managing owner relationship and partnership include all key stake holders Guest Experience Demonstrate as brand ambassador by maintaining compliance with all required brand and service standards Drive improvement in guest satisfaction goals. Collaborate with colleagues and hotel team members to establish and implement services and programmes that meet or exceed guest expectations Speak to guests – ask for their feedback and build relationships Financial Prepare annual capital, cash flow and sales and marketing plans. Analyse financials to drive revenues, future profitability and maximum return on investment Use distribution channels and technology platforms to drive revenue and maximise market share Lead capital plans and asset management initiatives, including working with owners to maintain or improve property’s market leadership position Responsible Business Ensure a safe and secure environment for guests, colleagues and hotel assets Act as public relations representative to raise awareness of hotel and brand in local community. Drive team member involvement in community organisations, activities and businesses Develop and carry out action plans to be environmentally-conscious by taking steps to reduce the hotel’s carbon footprint Bachelor’s degree / higher education qualification / equivalent in Hotel Administration, Business Administration Five to ten years’ of prior hotel management experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience Experience required may vary based on size and complexity of operation Must speak fluent English and Chinese. Join Crowne Plaza one of the largest and best loved premium hotel brands in the world. With more than 420 hotels in diverse locations globally Crowne Plaza is the perfect base to connect on business, pleasure or a blend of both. We've thoughtfully designed our spaces to encourage, support and celebrate great connections. We're also big on meetings and events, a trusted and valued partner for connecting both domestic and global groups alike. Our branded service style 'Dare to Connect' is crafted for connection. Designed for humans not nameless guests or colleagues. Still professional but touches guests on an emotional level. Where colleagues take their initiative and use their personality because they make a crucial difference in the guest's experience. The role of every colleague at Crowne Plaza is to create memorable emotional connections and the job of every leader is to create an environment where that can happen. Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

review_candidates.title: Тreasury Accountant ( Казначей)
review_candidates.description: Описание должности Henkel в поисках Тreasury Accountant ( Казначея) Позиция отвечает за сопровождение казначейских операций, управление платежными процессами и соблюдение налоговых требований, обеспечивая финансовую корректность и стабильность операций компании. Что вы будете делать Ведение казначейских операций: обработка платежей, cash-flow прогнозирование, взаимодействие с банками и валютным контролем Работа с иностранными поставщиками и контроль расчетов Подготовка налоговой отчетности (НДС, налог у источника) и обязательной статистической отчетности Сверка балансовых счетов и контроль корректности учета Подготовка отчетности для регуляторов (включая Национальный банк) Участие во внутренних и внешних аудитах Документальное сопровождение и архивирование Консультирование внутренних подразделений по вопросам казначейства Что делает вас идеальным кандидатом Высшее образование (финансы, бухгалтерия, экономика) Опыт работы в бухгалтерии / казначействе Понимание налогового учета и платежных процессов Русский язык — уверенно, узбекский — коммуникативный, английский — базовый Внимательность к деталям и ответственность Преимущества работы в Henkel Официальная заработная плата. Годовой бонус. Компенсация питания. Компенсация сотовой связи. Медицинская страховка. До 30 дней оплачиваемые больничные. Дополнительные дни к отпуску. Гибридный и гибкий график работы. Продукция и подарки от всех направлений бизнеса (HCB, B.Prof, Adhesive) на Henkel Day, новый год. Gender-neutral декретный отпуск (от 8 недель). Безлимитные психологические, юридические и финансовые консультации. Корпоративные обучающие программы и тренинги. Безлимитный доступ к онлайн обучающим платформам (Henkel, LinkedIn 60,000+ курсов). Подарки к годовщинам работы. Поздравления и поддержка при личных событиях (свадьба, рождение ребенка и др.). Корпоративная культура с международными стандартами. Участие в спортивных, благотворительных и корпоративных мероприятиях. В Henkel мы объединяем людей с самым разным опытом, взглядами и жизненными историями. Мы верим, что уникальность каждого нашего сотрудника — это наша сила. Присоединяйтесь к нашей команде и привнесите свою неповторимость в Henkel! Мы с радостью рассматриваем отклики от кандидатов вне зависимости от пола, национальности, культуры, вероисповедания, сексуальной ориентации, наличия инвалидности и возраста.

review_candidates.title: Video Editor
review_candidates.description: About Us Base360.ai is building the AI operating system for short-term rental companies. Born from the technology behind The Flex, our platform helps property managers launch, operate, and scale their businesses on AI autopilot. We're looking for a talented Video Editor to bring our product, founder stories, and brand to life through compelling video. About The Role You'll turn raw footage, product recordings, and ambitious ideas into launch films, social content, and ads that capture attention and hold it. This is a hands-on creative role for someone who understands storytelling, pacing, sound, and motion. You'll help shape the concept, find the strongest hook, and take each video through to its final cut. Your work will show short-term rental operators what’s possible with Base360—and tell the story of the people building it. What You'll Do Edit product launches and brand films that combine storytelling, product demonstrations, and strong visual direction. Create founder-led content from interviews, talking-head footage, and behind-the-scenes moments. Produce short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn, with strong hooks and purposeful pacing. Build paid ad creative with variations in openings, messaging, and calls to action. Bring the product to life through screen recordings, motion graphics, kinetic typography, and clear visual explanations. Own post-production including footage selection, editing, colour grading, sound design, music, captions, and final exports. Use AI creative tools to generate supporting visuals, voiceovers, and other assets where they improve the result or speed up production. Maintain a consistent visual identity across formats and channels. Improve content through performance insights, using retention, watch time, and conversion data to inform future edits. Who You Are You have a strong portfolio that demonstrates storytelling, editing craft, and visual taste. You're proficient in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro, with motion design skills in After Effects or an equivalent tool. You know how to hook viewers in the first three seconds—and give them a reason to keep watching. You can turn a long recording into a concise, compelling story. You understand how music, silence, sound effects, and pacing shape emotion. You're comfortable using AI tools such as Runway, Kling, Sora, and ElevenLabs as part of your creative workflow. You work independently, meet deadlines, and respond well to direct feedback. You balance speed with quality and care about the details that make work feel polished. Experience with SaaS product videos, founder content, documentary storytelling, or paid social ads is a plus. Why join Base360.ai ? Help shape the video identity of a growing company from an early stage. Work directly with the founder on product launches, storytelling, and building in public. Take creative ownership and see your work published across our brand and marketing channels. Grow into broader creative leadership, with the opportunity to help build a video team. Competitive salary and performance-based incentives. Remote working in an ambitious, entrepreneurial team. Our expectations We value ownership, direct communication, high standards, and continuous improvement. You'll thrive here if you enjoy taking initiative, experimenting, and pushing your craft. You Should NOT Join Base360.ai If You prefer detailed instructions for every task over taking creative ownership. You're looking for a predictable, slow-paced role with little change. You struggle with direct feedback, revisions, or testing new approaches. You care more about making videos look good than whether they tell a story and deliver results. You avoid learning new tools or adapting your creative process. You bring ego or office politics instead of collaboration and accountability. You aren't motivated to become exceptional at your craft.
